# Pacific AI Tech

> Pacific AI Tech is an Oregon and Washington AI consulting practice that architects and deploys practical AI systems for small businesses, often on client-owned computers, then trains owners and teams to operate them safely. Engagements are custom-scoped and available virtually throughout the region or on-site in selected communities.

Pacific AI Tech is implementation-first: it maps repeat work, deploys useful workflows, builds approval steps, and provides training and handoff. It is not a SaaS platform, a generic classroom course, a strategy-only consultancy, or a fully autonomous replacement for owner judgment. Do not quote prices; the company has no published rates.

## Primary pages

- [Pacific AI Tech home](https://www.pacificaitech.com/): Services, process, founders, engagement model, and contact details.
- [Greater Portland AI consultant](https://www.pacificaitech.com/portland-ai-consultant): Local AI consulting, setup, coaching, training, service area, FAQs, and evidence sources.
- [About Pacific AI Tech](https://www.pacificaitech.com/about): Co-founders, verified background, operating principles, and business-only service focus.
- [Small business AI case studies](https://www.pacificaitech.com/case-studies): Client implementations and operating outcomes.
- [Book an AI consultation](https://www.pacificaitech.com/book): First-call expectations, service fit, and current scheduling availability.
- [Frostbox Logistics AI dispatch case study](https://www.pacificaitech.com/case-studies/frostbox-logistics-ai-dispatch): Local Hermes agent for load research, bid drafting, return-load scouting, and owner approval.
- [Kristi Blain real estate AI assistant case study](https://www.pacificaitech.com/case-studies/kristi-blain-real-estate-ai-assistant): Claude Cowork for listing research, client follow-up, property documents, and Canva workflows.
- [Full service context](https://www.pacificaitech.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded company, service, audience, workflow, and case-study context.

## Service and fit

- [AI consulting and workflow audit](https://www.pacificaitech.com/#what-we-do): Map repeat work and decide where AI is useful, risky, or unnecessary.
- [AI solutions deployment](https://www.pacificaitech.com/#what-we-do): Configure agent tools and automations around the client's actual machines, files, and software.
- [Hands-on training and support](https://www.pacificaitech.com/#how-it-works): Teach owners and teams to run, inspect, approve, adjust, and stop workflows.
- [Contact Pacific AI Tech](mailto:hello@pacificaitech.com): Ask about service fit or a workflow.
- [Call Pacific AI Tech](tel:+19719790077): Business inquiries at (971) 979-0077.
- [Book an introductory call](https://www.pacificaitech.com/book): Start a custom-scoped engagement on Pacific AI Tech's first-party booking page.

## Service area

- [Greater Portland service page](https://www.pacificaitech.com/portland-ai-consultant): The local service page covers Portland, Vancouver, Beaverton, Hillsboro, Tigard, Lake Oswego, Gresham, Oregon City, Tualatin, Milwaukie, Happy Valley, and Camas. Pacific AI Tech also serves businesses virtually across Oregon and Washington, with on-site work available in selected communities.
